faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Questions about deployment, licensing, and review workflows

items.question: Where is contract data processed?
items.answer: Lexon AI is designed for self-hosted and local deployment. In standard deployments, contracts remain within customer-controlled infrastructure.

items.question: Does Lexon AI require external AI APIs?
items.answer: No. Lexon AI is designed to support local AI inference without requiring mandatory external AI services.

items.question: How should teams use Lexon AI?
items.answer: Lexon AI is designed for AI-assisted first-pass NDA review, clause analysis, workflow management, and structured internal review support.

items.question: Can Lexon AI replace legal counsel?
items.answer: No. Lexon AI is designed as review-support software to help teams identify potentially important clauses and accelerate review workflows.

items.question: What contract types are supported?
items.answer: Lexon AI currently supports NDAs and confidentiality agreements, with vendor agreements, DPAs, and MSAs on the roadmap.

items.question: Do you support other contract types?
items.answer: Yes - vendor agreements, DPAs, MSAs, and procurement contracts are planned. Visit our vision page for the full roadmap.
